BL-822 — resourceAnomalies stays empty through host load spikes: detector only trends per-role RSS/CPU and never samples uptime/load average
What it solves: Related same-shift context, do not merge: BL-815 (classify timeout fails
on a quiet host) and BL-816 (record a disposition when waving a red suite
through). Those address how roles behave under load; this one addresses
why the briefing's automated resource health line stayed quiet through it.
Approval context: Human via Cursor, 2026-08-06, draining Ask 3 / Flagged item 2 from docs/briefings/2026-08-06.md. The briefing offered two hypotheses (threshold too high, or not sampling uptime/load at all). Code reading settles it: the second. BL-350 made sampling run headless and left "what counts as an anomaly" …
BL-822 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-822" (or "reject BL-822 <reason>") to act.
